Design around the visitor’s next useful step.

I designed and developed a corporate product website and a specialist catalogue, connecting information structure, responsive presentation and enquiry entry points. The case is now anonymous: client names, direct domains, logos and identifiable screenshots are withheld.

These are two selected examples from a broader body of website and application work. They are not a lifetime delivery count or a measured business-improvement figure.

01ContextExplain the offer and organise the relevant product groups.
02DiscoveryConnect categories, detail and supporting information.
03Next actionMake enquiry entry points understandable.

Connect the design and implementation.

My contribution combines website design, content structure and WordPress implementation. The public builds use established platform, theme and plugin components; those foundations retain their original authorship.
